subject.title: docs: link canonical kit vision and shared launch direction

question: Should this repository publish the shared Kit direction only after https://github.com/dinkuskit/.github/pull/12 establishes the canonical public documents?
rationale: The README makes an external canonical product direction part of this repository's public entry point, and repository policy reserves merge approval to Bobby.

options.title: Sequence the dependent documentation first
options.body: Merge the canonical document PR, verify its main-branch links, then merge this narrow README update.

options.title: Keep the direction repository-local
options.body: Remove the cross-repository canonical links and retain only Inventory-owned public contract references until shared documents are approved.

recommendation.title: Sequence the dependent documentation first
recommendation.body: Merge the canonical document PR, verify its main-branch links, then merge this narrow README update.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy explicitly assigns Bobby approval over merges.
